entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts (DGI online edition cgici.com, wording of Ord. 2023-719) + Annexe fiscale 2025 (loi 2024-1109)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.statute: Code général des impôts (DGI online edition cgici.com, wording of Ord. 2023-719) + Annexe fiscale 2025 (loi 2024-1109)
entries.why: triage moderate: patente / contribution des patentes: business tax on traders and professions, not a household tax. listed by the registry (background (unverified)); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contributions à la charge des employeurs, local staff (contribution nationale 1,2 %, taxe d'apprentissage 0,4 %, FPC 1,2 %)
entries.statute: CGI (DGI online edition cgici.com, V2025) art. 134 4°, 143, 146 as amended by loi n° 2024-1109 du 18 déc. 2024 (annexe fiscale 2025) art. 16-2, 16-3
entries.doc: art. 146: local staff: contribution employeur proprement dite '-', contribution nationale pour le développement économique, culturel et social 1,2 %, taxe d'apprentissage 0,4 %, taxe additionnelle pour la formation professionnelle continue 1,2 %, total 2,8 % (expatriate staff 12 %); art. 134 4°: local staff exempt from the contribution proprement dite.
unsupported: expatriate staff (12 %): the household is local staff
exemptions for disabled staff and zone incentives (art. 134-142)

entries.name: CNPS old-age insurance, employer share (7,7 % up to the retirement ceiling)
entries.statute: CNPS Côte d'Ivoire, page 'Employeur' as captured on 14 September 2025 (Wayback 20250914213707; page last modified 3 January 2023; R4/fetch/p19/ci_cnps_employeur_wb20250914.html), Code de prévoyance sociale art. 23; the same rates and ceilings as the 2026 copy held earlier (ci/src/cnps_employeur.html) [text version: 2023 page as served in September 2025]
entries.doc: CNPS (facts restated): the retirement contribution is shared, 7,7 % employer and 6,3 % employee; ceiling 45 times the SMIG, now 19 767 780 F a year (1 647 315 FCFA a month).
unsupported: the printed ceiling does not equal 45 x the SMIG the page prints (flag: possibly stale); used as printed
SMIG floor on the contributory wage
the employee's 6,3 %

entries.name: CNPS family benefits 5 %, maternity 0,75 % and work accidents 2 % (employer only, up to 70 000 F a month)
entries.statute: CNPS Côte d'Ivoire, page 'Employeur' as captured on 14 September 2025 (Wayback 20250914213707; page last modified 3 January 2023; R4/fetch/p19/ci_cnps_employeur_wb20250914.html), Code de prévoyance sociale art. 23; the same rates and ceilings as the 2026 copy held earlier (ci/src/cnps_employeur.html) [text version: 2023 page as served in September 2025]
entries.doc: CNPS: '5 % pour les Prestations Familiales ; 0,75 % pour l'Assurance Maternité ; 2 à 5 % (selon le secteur d'activité) pour les Accidents du Travail ... à la charge exclusive de l'employeur'; 'Les plafonds sont de: 840 000 F par an (... 70 000 FCFA par mois)'.
unsupported: work-accident rate by sector (2 to 5 %): the lowest (2 %) is applied
SMIG floor

entries.name: Impôt sur le patrimoine foncier, built property producing rent (9 % of rental value)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 157-158 as amended by loi n° 2024-1109 (annexe fiscale 2025) art. 28-4
entries.doc: art. 158: 'Le taux de l'impôt sur le patrimoine foncier des immeubles bâtis et non bâtis productifs de revenus fonciers est fixé à 9 % de la valeur locative.'
unsupported: minimum of the previous year's amount for non-productive buildings
zone and sector exemptions (art. 158 bis, ter)

entries.name: Impôt sur le patrimoine foncier, owner-occupied main home (0,5 % of market value)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 157 al. 2, 158 as amended by loi n° 2024-1109 art. 28-4
entries.doc: art. 158: 'Il est de 0,5 % de la valeur marchande du bien immeuble bâti non productif de revenus dans les cas suivants : ... une seule habitation occupée par le propriétaire à titre d'habitation principale'; art. 157: base = declared market value checked by the valuation commission (art. 161 bis).
unsupported: one secondary residence at the same rate with a certificate
market value per the commission: the household's statutory value is used

entries.name: Impôt sur le patrimoine foncier des propriétés non bâties (1 % of market value)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 159-161, 164 1° [text version: CGI, DGI edition 2025 ('V2025' on cgici.com, incorporating the LF 2025 annex; R4/fetch/ci8/cgi2025_cgici.txt)]
entries.doc: art. 164 1°: 'Le taux de l'impôt sur le patrimoine foncier des propriétés non bâties est fixé à 1 % de la valeur marchande déterminée conformément aux dispositions de l'article 161'; art. 160: urban land.
unsupported: rural land outside art. 160 is not taxable (the household's land is treated as urban)

entries.name: Droit de mutation à titre onéreux d'immeubles (4 %)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 760 1° as amended by loi n° 2023-1000 (annexe fiscale 2024) art. 2-7
entries.doc: art. 760 1°: 'les adjudications, ventes, reventes, cessions ... et tous autres actes civils et judiciaires translatifs de propriété ou d'usufruit de biens immeubles à titre onéreux sont assujettis à un droit de 4 %'; also land transfers not made before a notary, on the price, borne by the buyer.
unsupported: half rate for charities and lessors in property leasing (art. 760 3°)
conservation foncière fees

entries.name: IRVM on dividends received by individuals (17 %)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 182 as amended by loi n° 2024-1109 (annexe fiscale 2025) art. 37-1
entries.doc: art. 182: 15 % for 'les produits et toutes les sommes imposables à l'impôt sur le revenu des valeurs mobilières non visés par le présent article'; 'Ce taux est porté à 17 % en ce qui concerne les revenus ci-dessus dont le bénéficiaire est une personne physique. Ce taux s'applique aux distributions effectuées à partir de l'année 2025.'
unsupported: dividends of BRVM-listed companies 12 % for individuals (art. 183 1-)
bonds of 5+ years 3 % (art. 183 2-)

entries.name: Impôt sur le revenu des créances on individuals' bank deposit interest (13,5 %)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 192-193 [text version: CGI, DGI edition 2025 ('V2025' on cgici.com, incorporating the LF 2025 annex; R4/fetch/ci8/cgi2025_cgici.txt)]
entries.doc: art. 193 1°: 'Le taux de l'impôt sur le revenu des créances est fixé à 18 %'; 2° a): deposits with banks, term up to 1 year, individuals ('Particuliers') 13,5 %; b) current accounts, individuals 13,5 %.
unsupported: longer deposit terms 10 / 5 / 1 % and other claims 18 %: the 13,5 % short-term / current-account rate is applied to all household interest

entries.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions and gifts: 1-5 % direct line and spouse after F 100 m; 6-12 % others)
entries.statute: CGI (cgici.com V2025) art. 730, 735, 737 (loi n° 2016-1116, annexe fiscale 2017, art. 3)
entries.doc: art. 735: on each heir's net share — direct line and spouses: up to 2 500 000 F 1 %, 2 500 000-10 000 000 2,5 %, 10 000 000-50 000 000 4 %, above 5 %; siblings 6 % to 10 000 000 and 8,5 % above; relatives to the 4th degree 10 %; beyond and non-relatives 12 %. art. 737: abatement of 100 000 000 F on the share of each child, each ascendant and the surviving spouse; art. 730: gifts taxed at the same rates with the same abatements.
unsupported: reduction for heirs with three or more children (art. 738)
50 % abatement on the home occupied by the surviving spouse
aggregation of earlier gifts from the same donor (art. 731)
25 % reduction for gifts by marriage contract (art. 730)
progressive bands read as marginal fractions ('Fraction de part nette taxable')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: CI CGI 2025 (complete DGI online code): no tax on net wealth; full-text search for 'impôt sur la fortune', 'patrimoine net', 'impôt de solidarité sur la fortune' finds nothing (the 'impôt sur le patrimoine foncier' is a recurrent property tax, P5)

entries.doc: CGI art. 910: the tax is due on every motor vehicle for the carriage of persons or goods registered in Côte d'Ivoire (cars, lorries, vans, tractors, motorcycles); art. 912: from the owner or holder named on the registration card; art. 913: for twelve months from the technical visit (motorcycles: the calendar year). Art. 915 tariff: two wheels 1 CV 5 000 F, above 12 000 F; more than two wheels up to 4 CV 19 000 F, 5-7 CV 35 000 F, 8-11 CV 49 000 F, 12-15 CV 96 000 F, above 15 CV 190 000 F, passenger cars above 15 CV under two years 250 000 F. Art. 916: a quarter off when the year of the technical visit less the year of first circulation exceeds 4. Art. 917: above 10, two wheels 3 500 / 6 000 F, more than two wheels 13 500 / 25 000 / 30 000 / 40 000 / 80 000 F. Read: the visit falls in 2025, so the difference is the kernel age (2025 - first registration year); the quarter of art. 916 is applied for differences of 5 to 10 and not on the art. 917 tariff (the DGI guide's floor of 13 500 F for vehicles of more than two wheels agrees). Worked cases (hand): 9 CV car of 2023 -> 49 000; 17 CV car of 2024 -> 250 000, of 2022 -> 190 000; 6 CV of 2018 -> 26 250; 13 CV of 2010 -> 40 000; motorcycle 1 CV of 2025 -> 5 000, 3 CV of 2012 -> 6 000; 20 CV lorry of 2025 -> 190 000. Eighteenth pass (pass 16 had the tariff as grade C: the CGI articles were in the held DGI edition all along).
unsupported: administrative vehicles (art. 918: 5 000 / 10 000 F) and exempt vehicles (art. 961) not distinguished
the art. 916 quarter is read as not applying on the art. 917 tariff (flag)
a vehicle without fiscal horsepower or first-registration year: listed (grade C)
